faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: Most weekend events book 6–12 months out. Weekday meetings often book 2–6 weeks ahead. Holiday parties: book by early fall.

faqs.q: Can we bring our own caterer?
faqs.a: Yes — and this is one of the biggest things that sets us apart. Most hotel ballrooms lock you into their in-house kitchen. We don't. You have two great options: (1) use our full in-house catering — plated dinners, buffets, carving stations, the full menu, prepared by Chef Ken and his team; or (2) bring your own caterer for cultural, family, kosher, halal, ethnic, or just-your-favorite-restaurant cuisine, with a modest catering fee. Whichever route you take, we provide tables, chairs, linens, china, glassware, silverware, and full kitchen access.

faqs.q: Can we bring our own cake or outside dessert?
faqs.a: Yes — outside cakes and desserts are welcome with a small cutting and plating fee.
